title: John Norseen's biofusion thought-controlled cockpit

tellings.quote: In 1999, Norseen published a report on biofusion, a system he later described involving brain-computer interfaces that convert thoughts into commands.

plain: In 1999 a researcher named John Norseen, who worked with Lockheed Martin, published a report titled "Biofusion Reflexive Control and Neuro-ergonomic Integration in Adaptive Cockpits." Michels says Norseen later described it as a system that uses brain-computer interfaces to "convert thoughts into commands," in effect a cockpit run by the pilot's mind. Michels tells it himself, on an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor. If true, thought-controlled aircraft were being worked on decades ago.
